two_subsystems.A_cognitive: apiCreateMission → cognitiveAnalyze(instruction) → pierre_rt_tasks → worker.ts resolveExecutor(task.type) → executors.ts. This is what a natural-language instruction drives. Its executor registry (status_update, email_send, …) NEVER calls RUNTIME_ACTION_HANDLERS and never uses hr-mission-packs.
two_subsystems.B_governed: createMissionRunFromPlan(mission_id, plan) → compileMissionPlan → pierre_rt_step_runs + pierre_rt_runtime_jobs → runPierreRuntimeJobs → RUNTIME_ACTION_HANDLERS[action_key]. This is where the authoritative perf/training actions actually execute. Payload = the step's compile-time input_json.
two_subsystems.bridge: hr-mission-packs compile into Subsystem-B plans via packToRuntimePlan(pack). But NOTHING auto-selects a pack from an instruction and runs it; compileMissionPack is only exercised at test/build time. The only wired instruction→plan→handlers path is the cognitive planner (generateCognitivePlan → startCognitiveExecution → createMissionRunFromPlan), which emits action_keys directly and does NOT use hr-mission-packs.

architecture_finding.no_output_threading: The governed runtime does NOT thread an upstream step's output into a downstream step's input. Each step's payload is its immutable compile-time input_json (pinned by input_hash); pierre_rt_runtime_cascade only advances dependency counters, it never copies output_json → input_json. Consequence: a step that needs a runtime-GENERATED id (e.g. performance.campaign.population.build needs the campaign_id created by performance.campaign.create) CANNOT be expressed in a single compiled plan. Multi-step chains are only expressible when later steps reference a shared BUSINESS KEY (requirement_key, policy_key, campaign_key) known at compile time.
architecture_finding.proof: src/lib/pierre/v1/__integration__/p22-authoritative-worker-e2e.itest.ts — a key-based training chain (policy_key→requirement_key→validate_source→approval→resume) runs end-to-end through the real worker; a plan containing population.build with an empty campaign_id compiles to zero steps (the invalid-input step drops the run).

honest_status.authoritative_worker_path_proven: YES — real perf/training authoritative actions execute through runPierreRuntimeJobs with a human approval gate + governed resume (p22-authoritative-worker-e2e). This is NOT a direct handler call.

Both are real runtime changes beyond this reprise.
